text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you came to see it too, Bourbon?
The special exhibition, "Traces of the Triple Crown Horse Girls"!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The Triple Crown is my highest priority objective.
This is an unparalleled research opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah! Then let's head in together!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Touring around with a fellow Triple Crown fanatic—sounds super fun, doesn't it!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Look, look! They're playing race footage from back then!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this race...
There was a massive gap midway through, right?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, she will advance from here.
Initiating charge... acceleration... what a stride...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It was truly as dynamic as if she had sprouted wings.
A vast stamina reserve made that extension possible—
Truly otherworldly stats...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Requesting instant replay. From the beginning this time.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Agreed~! Next time I wanna check her positioning too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's the Monthly Twinkle Special Issue! "Everything About Triple Crown Horse Girls Right Here"... it says!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...! I shall purchase 5 copies.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good, 5 copies! ...Wait, 5 copies!?
Umm, one for reading, one for lending to friends, and... No, no, do you really need that many!?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
All of them are backup copies.
They will degrade with repeated reading loops.
(Slurp~~~~!)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Phaa! This "Sanshoku Soba" is delicious~!
I heard it's not on the regular menu anymore, but you used to be able to eat it at Tokyo Racecourse in the past, right?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes. It appears to have made a limited revival specifically for this exhibition's special cafe.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The taste is an exact match for the data in my memory storage.
...The taste I had as a child.

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Shall we get something to eat after watching the Derby?
Japanese, Western, Chinese, or maybe even some sweet desserts?"

text_block_list.name: Young Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"No... nothing in particular.
Whatever you would like to eat, Father."

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text:
"...Is there really nothing you're interested in, Bourbon?
Yeah, I see... let's do that then."

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"She wins~~!! With this, the Classic Double Crown!
A magnificent run, giving every fiber of her body and soul!!"

text_block_list.name: Double Crown Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
"Haah... haah... I didn't care what happened to me.
My legs, my heart, everything... I ran giving it all.
...Because... the Triple Crown is—"

text_block_list.name: Double Crown Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: "It's my... dream!!"

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Well, let's head out soon.
...Whoa, that shop has a huge line."

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text:
"The 'Sanshoku Soba' there is that girl's... the future Triple Crown winner's favorite dish.
Guess everyone wants to eat it to commemorate her victory."

text_block_list.name: Young Bourbon
text_block_list.text: "The future Triple Crown winner's..."

text_block_list.name: Young Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"F-Father.
I am interested in it too... the 'Sanshoku Soba'!"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
This flavor is linked.
Linked to the shock of seeing that run where she gave her everything.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: On that day, when I was captivated by racing and realized the true weight of the Triple Crown—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Without any computation, it was directly input into my heart.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I want to run... I want to claim the Triple Crown.
...It was the first will of my own that ever sprouted.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I see... so you're just like me.
Just like when I saw the Kaicho's race for the first time.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
She was so strong and cool, and I wanted to be like that so badly.
Before I knew it, I was running!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Even now... no.
Forever and ever, she'll always be my idol!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
An idol... yes.
Precisely so.
On a certain holiday, the figure of a horse girl could be seen on the training track—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Today's tasks completed.
Transitioning to additional training regimen.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...In order to reach my aspiration.
choice_data_list: (She's pushing herself hard... I hope she's okay.)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...In order to reach my aspiration.
choice_data_list: (She's pushing herself hard... I hope she's okay.)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Calculating remaining time until sunset.
—Calculation complete. 10 laps is the limit threshold.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...No, 20 laps.
I will accomplish this...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Component status checks... all normal.
Increasing workload parameter.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Adding squats and high-speed high knees prior to sprints.
Initiating sequence...!
